name: Sopa de Tortilla (vegetarian)
ingredients: 2 dried guajillo or Kashmiri chillies (soaked, blended)
6 corn tortillas (cut into strips, fried crisp)
½ cup crumbled queso fresco or paneer
preparation: Sauté onion and garlic in oil; add chilli paste and tomato purée; cook 8 minutes.
Add stock, cumin, oregano, beans and corn; simmer 15 minutes; season.
Ladle into bowls; top with crisp tortilla strips, avocado, cheese, coriander and lime.

name: Black Bean Soup
preparation: Sauté onion, garlic, capsicum and jalapeño in oil 5 minutes.
Add beans, stock, cumin, paprika and oregano; simmer 20 minutes.
Blend half the soup and return for body; add lime juice and salt.
Serve with sour cream and coriander.

name: Sopa de Fideo
preparation: Toast the fideo in oil, stirring, until golden; remove.
Sauté onion and garlic; add tomato purée, cook 5 minutes.
Add stock, cumin, oregano and fideo; simmer 10 minutes until tender.
Season; serve with coriander and lime.

name: Sopa de Elote (Mexican corn soup)
ingredients: ½ cup crumbled queso fresco or paneer
preparation: Soften onion and garlic in butter; add 2 cups corn and stock; simmer 10 minutes.
Blend smooth; return with milk, remaining corn, poblano and cumin; simmer 5 minutes.
Season; serve with cheese, coriander and a dusting of chilli powder.

name: Caldo de Verduras (Mexican vegetable broth)
preparation: Sauté onion and garlic; add tomatoes and cook 3 minutes.
Add all vegetables, stock and cumin; simmer 20 minutes.
Season; serve with coriander, lime and jalapeño slices.

name: Loaded Nachos
ingredients: 1½ cups cooked black beans (warmed with ½ tsp cumin)
preparation: Spread chips on a tray, scatter beans and both cheeses.
Bake at 200°C for 8–10 minutes until melted.
Top with pico de gallo, jalapeños, sour cream, guacamole and coriander.

name: Elote (Mexican street corn)
ingredients: ½ cup crumbled cotija or paneer
preparation: Grill or roast corn, turning, until charred in spots, 10–12 minutes; brush with butter.
Mix mayonnaise and sour cream; slather over the hot cobs.
Roll in crumbled cheese, dust with chilli powder, squeeze lime, scatter coriander.

name: Esquites (corn salad cups)
ingredients: ½ cup crumbled cotija or paneer
preparation: Char corn in butter in a hot pan 6–8 minutes with jalapeño.
Toss with mayonnaise, lime juice, cheese, chilli powder, coriander and salt.
Serve warm in cups.

name: Jalapeño Poppers (eggless)
ingredients: ½ cup maida mixed with ½ cup water (slurry)
preparation: Mix cream cheese, cheddar, coriander, garlic powder and salt; fill jalapeño halves.
Dip in slurry, coat in breadcrumbs.
Deep-fry until golden, or bake at 200°C for 18 minutes.

name: Black Bean Empanadas (eggless)
preparation: Rub butter into maida and salt; add water to form a dough; rest 30 minutes.
Sauté onion and garlic; add beans, cumin and chilli; cook 5 minutes; cool, mix in cheese.
Roll dough, cut circles, fill, fold and crimp; brush with milk.
Bake at 200°C for 20–25 minutes until golden.

name: Baked Taquitos
preparation: Warm tortillas so they roll without cracking.
Spread beans, cheese, corn and chilli powder along one edge; roll tightly.
Brush with oil, bake seam-down at 220°C for 18–20 minutes until crisp.
Serve with salsa and sour cream.

name: Cheese Quesadillas
preparation: Scatter cheeses, capsicum, corn and coriander over half of each tortilla; fold.
Cook in butter on a pan 2–3 minutes each side until golden and melted.
Cut into wedges; serve with salsa.

name: Sopes with Beans and Cheese
ingredients: 2 cups masa harina (corn flour for tortillas)
½ cup crumbled queso fresco or paneer
preparation: Mix masa harina, salt and water into a soft dough; form 12 thick discs and pinch up a rim.
Cook on a dry pan 2 minutes each side; then fry briefly in oil until crisp-edged.
Top with beans, lettuce, cheese, salsa verde and sour cream.

name: Bean and Cheese Burritos
preparation: Warm tortillas; layer beans, rice, cheese, pico de gallo, sour cream and avocado down the centre.
Fold sides in and roll tightly.
Sear seam-down in oil 2 minutes each side to seal and crisp.

name: Vegetable Enchiladas Rojas
ingredients: 2 cups salsa roja or enchilada sauce
preparation: Sauté onion, garlic, zucchini, capsicum and corn; add beans and cumin; cook 5 minutes.
Warm tortillas, dip each in sauce, fill and roll; arrange seam-down in a dish.
Pour remaining sauce over, top with cheese.
Bake at 190°C for 20 minutes; serve with coriander and sour cream.

name: Spinach Enchiladas Verdes
ingredients: 2 cups salsa verde (tomatillo or green tomato)
½ cup crumbled queso fresco or paneer
preparation: Sauté onion and garlic; mix with spinach, cream cheese and half the mozzarella.
Fill tortillas, roll, arrange in a dish over a thin layer of salsa verde.
Cover with remaining salsa and mozzarella; bake at 190°C for 20 minutes.
Finish with sour cream, queso fresco and coriander.

name: Chiles Rellenos (eggless batter)
preparation: Char chillies over a flame or under a grill; steam in a covered bowl 10 minutes, peel, slit and seed, keeping stems.
Stuff with cheese; close with toothpicks.
Whisk maida, cornflour, baking powder, salt and sparkling water; dip chillies and deep-fry until golden.
Serve in warm salsa roja with coriander.

name: Black Bean Tacos
ingredients: ½ cup crumbled queso fresco or paneer
preparation: Sauté onion and garlic; add beans, spices, lime juice and salt; mash lightly and cook 5 minutes.
Warm tortillas on a dry pan.
Fill with beans, lettuce, pico de gallo, cheese and avocado.

name: Mushroom Tacos
preparation: Sear mushrooms in hot oil until browned; add onion and garlic, cook 3 minutes.
Add spices, lime juice and salt.
Warm tortillas; fill with mushrooms, salsa verde, sour cream and coriander.

name: Vegetable Fajitas
preparation: Toss onions, capsicum, mushrooms and paneer with garlic, spices and salt.
Stir-fry in very hot oil 6–8 minutes until charred at the edges; add lime juice.
Serve sizzling with warm tortillas, guacamole, sour cream and pico de gallo.

name: Chilaquiles Rojos
ingredients: ½ cup crumbled queso fresco or paneer
preparation: Fry tortilla wedges until crisp; drain.
Simmer salsa roja with stock 5 minutes.
Toss chips in the hot salsa just until coated but still crisp; add beans.
Top with cheese, sour cream, onion, avocado and coriander; serve immediately.

name: Vegetable Tostadas
preparation: Fry tortillas flat in oil until crisp; drain.
Spread refried beans over each.
Layer lettuce, pico de gallo, cheese, avocado, sour cream, salsa and jalapeños.

name: Stuffed Poblano Peppers
ingredients: 6 poblano or large green capsicums (halved, seeded)
preparation: Sauté onion and garlic; add rice, beans, corn, tomatoes, spices and salt; cook 5 minutes; fold in half the cheese.
Fill pepper halves, top with remaining cheese.
Bake covered at 190°C for 25 minutes, uncovered 10 minutes.

name: Enfrijoladas
ingredients: 3 cups cooked black beans (with 1 cup of their liquid)
1 dried chipotle or 1 tsp chilli powder
1 cup crumbled queso fresco or paneer
preparation: Sauté chopped onion and garlic; blend with beans, their liquid, cumin, chipotle and salt into a smooth sauce; warm through.
Warm tortillas, dip each in the bean sauce, fold into quarters and arrange on plates.
Spoon extra sauce over; top with cheese, sour cream, sliced onion and coriander.

name: Sweet Potato and Black Bean Tacos
ingredients: ½ cup crumbled queso fresco or paneer
preparation: Toss sweet potato with oil, spices and salt; roast at 220°C for 25 minutes.
Warm beans with lime juice and a pinch of salt.
Warm tortillas; fill with sweet potato, beans, cabbage, cheese, avocado and coriander.

name: Paneer Tinga Tacos
ingredients: 2 chipotle chillies in adobo (chopped) or 2 tsp smoked chilli paste
preparation: Sauté onion and garlic; add tomato purée, chipotle, oregano and cumin; simmer 10 minutes.
Add paneer and stock; simmer 5 minutes until the sauce clings.
Warm tortillas; fill with tinga, lettuce, sour cream, onion and coriander.

name: Arroz Rojo (Mexican red rice)
preparation: Toast rice in oil until pale gold; add onion and garlic.
Add tomato purée, tomato paste and cumin; cook 3 minutes.
Add stock, peas, carrot and salt; cover and simmer 18 minutes; rest 5 minutes and fluff.

name: Cilantro Lime Rice
preparation: Cook rice with water, oil and salt until fluffy.
Fold in lime juice, zest and coriander while hot.

name: Arroz Verde (green rice)
preparation: Blend coriander, spinach, poblano, garlic and 1 cup of the stock into a green purée.
Toast rice in oil with onion 3 minutes.
Add the purée, remaining stock and salt; cover and simmer 18 minutes; fluff with lime juice.

name: Mexican Quinoa
preparation: Sauté onion and garlic; add quinoa and spices, stir 1 minute.
Add tomatoes, beans, corn and stock; cover and simmer 18 minutes.
Fluff with lime juice and coriander.

name: Black Beans and Rice
preparation: Sauté onion, capsicum and garlic in oil 5 minutes.
Add rice, beans, cumin, oregano, bay leaf and stock; cover and simmer 20 minutes.
Rest 5 minutes; fluff with lime juice.

name: Sopa Seca de Fideo (Mexican noodle bake)
ingredients: ½ cup crumbled queso fresco or paneer
preparation: Toast fideo in oil until golden; remove.
Sauté onion and garlic; add tomato purée, cumin and chilli; cook 5 minutes.
Return fideo with stock and salt; cover and simmer 10 minutes until absorbed.
Top with cheese, sour cream and coriander.

name: Calabacitas con Arroz
preparation: Sauté onion and garlic; add rice, stir 2 minutes.
Add zucchini, corn, tomatoes, stock, cumin and salt; cover and simmer 18 minutes.
Fold in cheese and coriander.

name: Corn and Rice Casserole
preparation: Soften onion in butter; mix with rice, corn, sour cream, half the cheese, poblano, cumin and salt.
Transfer to a dish; top with remaining cheese and breadcrumbs.
Bake at 190°C for 25 minutes until golden.

name: Refried Beans (frijoles refritos)
ingredients: 3 cups cooked pinto or kidney beans (with 1 cup of their liquid)
½ cup crumbled queso fresco or paneer
preparation: Sauté onion, garlic and jalapeño in oil 5 minutes.
Add beans and their liquid; mash with a potato masher while simmering.
Cook 10 minutes to a thick, creamy paste; season with cumin, lime and salt; top with cheese. No lard — oil only.

name: Calabacitas (zucchini and corn)
ingredients: ½ cup crumbled queso fresco or paneer
preparation: Sauté onion, garlic and jalapeño 3 minutes.
Add zucchini, corn, tomatoes, cumin and salt; cook 8 minutes until just tender.
Top with cheese and coriander.

name: Rajas con Crema
ingredients: 6 poblano or green capsicums (roasted, peeled, sliced)
preparation: Soften onion and garlic in butter.
Add poblano strips and corn; cook 5 minutes.
Stir in cream and cheese; simmer 3 minutes until thick; season.

name: Frijoles Charros (vegetarian cowboy beans)
ingredients: 3 cups cooked pinto or kidney beans (with 1½ cups of their liquid)
preparation: Sauté onion, garlic and jalapeño; add tomatoes and cook 5 minutes.
Add beans with liquid, cumin, paprika and oregano; simmer 20 minutes, brothy not dry.
Season; finish with coriander.

name: Corn Tortillas
ingredients: 2 cups masa harina (corn flour for tortillas)
preparation: Mix masa harina, salt and water into a soft dough; rest 15 minutes.
Divide into 12 balls; press between two sheets of plastic with a heavy pan into thin rounds.
Cook on a very hot dry pan 45 seconds each side until puffed and spotted; keep wrapped in a cloth.

name: Flour Tortillas
preparation: Mix maida, baking powder and salt; rub in oil; add water to form a soft dough; rest 30 minutes.
Divide into 12, roll very thin.
Cook on a hot dry pan 30–40 seconds each side until bubbled and golden-spotted.

name: Eggless Cornbread
preparation: Mix milk with lemon juice; rest 5 minutes.
Whisk dry ingredients; add milk mixture and butter; fold in corn and jalapeño.
Pour into a greased 20 cm tin; bake at 200°C for 25–30 minutes until golden.

name: Guacamole
preparation: Mash avocados with lime juice and salt, leaving some texture.
Fold in onion, tomato, jalapeño and coriander; serve at once.

name: Pico de Gallo
preparation: Combine everything; rest 10 minutes for the flavours to mingle.
Drain excess liquid before serving.

name: Salsa Roja
preparation: Char tomatoes, onion, garlic and fresh chillies on a dry pan until blistered.
Blend with soaked chillies, cumin, lime juice, coriander and salt.
Simmer in oil 5 minutes; cool. Keeps refrigerated 5 days.

name: Salsa Verde
preparation: Boil tomatillos, chillies, onion and garlic 8 minutes until soft.
Blend with coriander, lime juice, sugar and salt; cool.

name: Churros (eggless)
ingredients: 100 g dark chocolate (melted with ¼ cup milk, for dipping)
preparation: Boil water, butter, 1 tbsp sugar and salt; off heat, beat in maida until smooth; add vanilla.
Pipe 10 cm lengths through a star nozzle into hot oil; fry until deep golden.
Roll in cinnamon sugar; serve with warm chocolate sauce.

name: Eggless Tres Leches Cake
ingredients: 1 cup evaporated milk or full-fat milk (for soak)
1½ cups fresh cream (whipped with 2 tbsp sugar, for topping)
preparation: Whisk dry ingredients; add milk, oil, lemon juice and vanilla; pour into a 20 cm tin; bake at 180°C for 30–35 minutes.
Mix condensed milk, evaporated milk and cream; poke the warm cake all over and pour the soak over slowly.
Chill 4 hours; top with whipped cream and cinnamon.

name: Arroz con Leche (Mexican rice pudding)
preparation: Simmer rice with water and the cinnamon stick until the water is absorbed.
Add milk, sugar and condensed milk; simmer stirring 25 minutes until creamy.
Stir in vanilla and raisins; serve warm or chilled with ground cinnamon.

name: Sopapillas
preparation: Rub butter into maida, baking powder, salt and sugar; add water to form a dough; rest 20 minutes.
Roll thin, cut into squares.
Deep-fry until puffed and golden; drizzle honey and dust with cinnamon sugar.

name: Horchata
ingredients: 1 cup long-grain rice (soaked overnight in 2 cups water)
preparation: Blend the soaked rice, cinnamon stick and its water with 3 cups fresh water until smooth.
Strain through a fine cloth; stir in milk, sugar and vanilla.
Serve over ice with a dusting of cinnamon.
